description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: Generic LTO 18650-class cell (Li4Ti5O12 anode vs LMO/NMC cathode)
cell.source: Takami et al. (2011), J. Power Sources 196, 6989; Toshiba SCiB datasheet

R_ref.note: Internal resistance at T_ref (298.15 K), very low for LTO

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative LTO discharge curve (flat ~2.4 V plateau); Takami et al. (2011)

E_a.note: Activation energy for LTO internal resistance; LTO has lower E_a due to faster Li+ insertion kinetics in spinel structure
E_a.source: He et al. (2013), J. Power Sources 239, 269-276; Keil & Jossen (2016), J. Electrochem. Soc. 163(9), A1872

alpha_c.note: Linear capacity temperature coefficient; LTO less sensitive than NMC
alpha_c.source: Bernardi et al. (1985), J. Electrochem. Soc. 132, 5

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient for LTO; smaller than NMC due to flat OCV plateau
dOCV_dT.source: Kobayashi et al. (2013), J. Power Sources 244, 727-734

current.note: Negative=charge, Positive=discharge; LTO supports very high C-rates

temperature.note: -30 to 60 degC; LTO operates well at low temperatures
